definitions.explanation: The ability to endure difficult circumstances or wait calmly without complaining; putting up with hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{辛抱|しんぼう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be patient a little longer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}{強|づよ}く→辛抱強い：18963_shinbouzuyoi⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
{辛抱|しんぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I've reached the limit of my patience.

notes:
{辛抱|しんぼう} means enduring hardship or waiting patiently through difficult circumstances without complaining.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {辛抱|しんぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be patient, to endure
- ⟦{辛抱|しんぼう}{強|づよ}い→辛抱強い：18963_shinbouzuyoi⟧: patient, persevering
- {辛抱|しんぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: lacking patience
- {辛抱|しんぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧: limit of patience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {辛抱|しんぼう}: enduring hardship steadfastly; implies long-term suffering with dignity
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧: restraining oneself, holding back; more everyday and common
- ⟦{忍耐|にんたい}→忍耐：05212_nintai⟧: patience, perseverance (formal, literary)
- ⟦{根気|こんき}→根気：02734_konki⟧: persistence, sticking with a task

USAGE:
{辛抱|しんぼう} has a warmer, more old-fashioned feel than ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧. Often used by older speakers or in encouraging contexts: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{辛抱|しんぼう}⟦してね→する：00392_suru⟧ (hang in there a bit longer).

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧ is more common in casual speech.
